_note: Bundled partner recommendations shown in the Security Center. Replace each `url` with your approved affiliate/tracking link as programs are approved; ship updates via normal extension releases (MV3 forbids remotely-loaded logic; remotely swapping this file is not needed and static bundling keeps review simple). Links must only open on explicit user click — never auto-apply codes or cookies (CWS affiliate policy, June 2025).
disclosure: Some of these are partner links — DrivePass may earn a commission if you buy, at no extra cost to you. This is what keeps DrivePass free. We only list tools we believe genuinely improve your security.

offers.title: NordVPN
offers.tagline: Encrypt your traffic on public Wi-Fi
offers.benefit: Passwords are only half the story — a VPN stops snooping on airport, café, and hotel networks where logins are most exposed.

offers.title: Surfshark
offers.benefit: One subscription covers every device you own — useful if your whole household shares logins you keep in DrivePass.

offers.title: YubiKey
offers.benefit: The strongest 2FA there is. Even if a password leaks, an attacker can't sign in without the physical key — protect your Google account, and your vault protects itself.

offers.title: DeleteMe
offers.tagline: Remove your info from data brokers
offers.benefit: Data brokers publish the personal details attackers use for password-reset and phishing attacks. DeleteMe scrubs them on your behalf, continuously.

offers.title: Aura
offers.benefit: Monitors the dark web for your accounts, alerts on new credit activity, and insures against identity theft — the safety net for when a breach does happen.

offers.title: Backblaze
offers.benefit: Ransomware can't blackmail you if your files live safely off-machine. Simple, automatic, unlimited backup for a few dollars a month.
